svg.title: Rádio Comunitária
svg.desc: Ilustração original do desafio Rádio Comunitária.
svg.metadata: {"generator": "image_gen built-in", "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Use the attached illustration ONLY as the shared STYLE and CHARACTER REFERENCE: premium detailed pixel art, crisp small pixels, subtle dithering, dimensional light, richly layered cozy Brazilian town adventure art. Retain the SAME Black teenage heroine with dark brown skin, voluminous short curly afro hair, lavender purple jacket, cream shirt, navy trousers and white-soled sneakers. Create ONE wholly NEW finished VOICES game-selection cover depicting the described different challenge; replace the entire scene and character pose. Wide 20:9 landscape (approximately 1870x841), edge-to-edge key art for a 640x288 card. Clear readable action at thumbnail size; main subjects within the central 75 percent height. No lettering, text, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, interface, HUD, borders, screenshot look, photorealism, toy 3D or smooth vector illustration. Challenge: Rádio Comunitária. A cozy richly detailed neighborhood radio studio at blue-hour dusk, seen from an inviting three-quarter angle. The heroine sits at a beautifully crafted teal and walnut broadcast mixing desk, wearing padded headphones and carefully turning a prominent brass tuning knob. THREE distinct glowing signal channels on the desk are the key motif: three separate horizontal glass dial windows with amber, mint and lavender waveform traces, with matching physical knobs and slider faders. A classic broadcast microphone on an articulated arm is beside her. Reel-to-reel recorder, cassette tapes, a few records, wooden acoustic slats, books and leafy plants give the studio character. Through an arched window, warm town rooftops and a moonlit sky are visible. Gentle warm amber lamplight against cool teal shadows, tactile wood and brass, welcoming community atmosphere. Focus clearly on tuning and broadcasting rather than an office computer. NO lettering, station name, numbers, labels, interface text, posters with writing, or logos."}
